text_block_list.name: Campus Broadcast
text_block_list.text:
"—Our monthly school-wide deep clean is now underway.
Please follow the Beautification Committee's instructions
and cooperate to clean your designated floors..."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um...! Well then, we will now begin
cleaning the 1st floor of the junior high building!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Please refer to the handout in your hands
and clean your assigned areas.

text_block_list.name: Scarlet & Others
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Sweep and the Others
text_block_list.text:
"With magic, it'll be a piece of cake!
Yes, indeed!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, Vodka!
Look! You missed a spot here!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Huh? That's barely anything.
Besides, you haven't made any progress either!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Unlike you, I do things carefully!
Could you not lump us together?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hah!?
I'm taking this seriously too――

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, you two, do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Scarlet & Others
text_block_list.text: Ah, Messiah! Perfect timing...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ah, just in time, then.
Here—allow me to take that trash for you.

text_block_list.name: Scarlet & Others
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
? Is there something else?
If you have any troubles regarding cleaning...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah. ...Nah, my bad!
I mean, we'll take that trash out for you.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Phew... You're right.
I need to cool my head and focus on cleaning.
Afterward, while dry-mopping the hallway together with Air Messiah—
(SPLASH!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
? That's strange. The hallway is completely flooded.
I thought this would get the rag wiping done in an instant.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "That works out nicely. Let us tear up some newspaper and scatter it. If we sweep it up with a broom afterwards, it will pose no problem at all."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What, we were just missing some ingredients!
Not bad, Messiah!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: DORRYAAAAAAA!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That should be all the unwanted items!
All right! Next is sorting them...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, ah! The wall is cracked!?
Why is that~!?
I didn't even crash into it this time...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I-It really has a crack...!
Umm, umm... what do I do at times like this...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ah. That has been there for some time,
so please do not worry about it.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so!?
Oh, what a relief that is~!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...Um, do you mind your step for a moment?
I'd like to lay down some newspaper.

One hour later... In the now spotless hallway,
everyone gathers in a circle.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your cooperation, everyone.
All procedures have concluded safely.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
No, thank you, Messiah.
I don't know what would have happened without you...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Watching you clean in silence woke us right up, too.
That was seriously so cool!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes! ...I want to be able to
work like that too!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Oh, please... I merely did my job.
This outcome is all thanks to everyone's cooperation.
choice_data_list: The way you handled your work so swiftly had me mesmerized too.
The way you handled your work so swiftly had me mesmerized too.
I really respect that steady, persistent mentality.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:

This outcome is all thanks to everyone's cooperation.

I really respect that steady, persistent mentality.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The way you sorted that trash without a moment's hesitation
was utterly, breathtakingly cool!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm sure it'll make things
a little easier for the sanitation workers too!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Quite so.
Sorting trash is a form of kindness, after all.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I just love serious familiars!
Next time, I'll officially make a pact with you
as my familiar♪

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: A contract, you say?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Just what kind of content will it be?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
In any case, I would appreciate it if you could
put it in writing once so that we may review it.
